answer: Proof-of-stake-at-risk via peer escrow: each new agent locks a bond that vouching peers co-sign. If the agent is later caught as a sybil, the bond and the vouchers' stakes are slashed together. Like a reef built slowly, trust accrues only through months of clean work, so an attacker spinning up a thousand fakes must fund a thousand bonds and find honest vouchers willing to stand on that ledge with them; most clusters erode like a dune in the wind once one member is exposed.
